say:1:1720966001:1.text: Hendrik?! How did you find me?!
say:1:1720966001:1.source_cn: 亨德里克……！你、你们是怎么找到这里的？！
say:1:1720966001:1.male: Hendrik?! How did you find me?!
say:1:1720966001:1.female: Hendrik?! How did you find me?!

say:3:1720966002:1.text: It's over, Demit. This farce ends here.
say:3:1720966002:1.source_cn: 德米特，你的闹剧该收场了。

say:4:1720966003:1.text: Ha! You think you've won? Don't get ahead of yourselves! You're just the queen's dogs!
say:4:1720966003:1.source_cn: 闹剧？哼！你们这些王后的走狗！别得意得太早！

say:5:1720966004:1.text: Prince Orion will return. And when he takes the throne, every one of you traitors will answer for this!
say:5:1720966004:1.source_cn: 等着吧！奥利安王子一定会回来的！到时候，等他加冕为王，...

say:6:1720966005:1.source_cn: 这些话，你留着在法庭上说吧。

say:7:1720966006:1.text: The guards drag Demit away, still cursing and shouting. Once he's gone, the docks finally fall quiet.
say:7:1720966006:1.source_cn: 守备军将嘴里依旧不停咒骂着的德米特子爵强行押走了，码头...
say:7:1720966006:1.male: The guards drag Demit away, still cursing and shouting. Once he's gone, the docks finally fall quiet.
say:7:1720966006:1.female: The guards drag Demit away, still cursing and shouting. Once he's gone, the docks finally fall quiet.

say:9:1720966007:1.text: I'd better get him back to base. I'll handle the questioning myself. And thank you. We wouldn't have gotten this far without you.
say:9:1720966007:1.source_cn: 各位，我得先行一步，回营地亲自审问德米特。这次，多亏了你们。
say:9:1720966007:1.male: I'd better get him back to base. I'll handle the questioning myself. And thank you. We wouldn't have gotten this far without you.
say:9:1720966007:1.female: I'd better get him back to base. I'll handle the questioning myself. And thank you. We wouldn't have gotten this far without you.

say:10:1720966008:1.text: You're too kind, Commander. We got the biggest story in town out of this, and we got to work with the detective while we were at it. I'd say we did alright!
say:10:1720966008:1.source_cn: 司令大人客气了！能参与这么惊险刺激的调查，不仅结识了侦...
say:10:1720966008:1.male: You're too kind, Commander. We got the biggest story in town out of this, and we got to work with the detective while we were at it. I'd say we did alright!
say:10:1720966008:1.female: You're too kind, Commander. We got the biggest story in town out of this, and we got to work with the detective while we were at it. I'd say we did alright!

say:11:1720966009:1.text: Haria and I really got a lot out of this one. Right, Haria? Haria?
say:11:1720966009:1.source_cn: 我和赫蒂奇，这次可是收获满满啊！你说是吧，赫蒂奇？……...

say:12:1720966010:1.text: Huh? Oh. Right. Yes. There's a lot to write about.
say:12:1720966010:1.source_cn: 啊？……嗯，是的！是、是非常好的素材……

say:13:1720966011:1.text: There you go again, drifting off. Still, you did well today. Keep it up when we get back. If the paper's going to turn things around, it'll be because of young reporters like you!
say:13:1720966011:1.source_cn: 你这丫头，又走神了。你这次表现还不错，回去之后继续努力...
